== Tuon's name ==

I reverted your edit to Tuon's page. I would like to explain my reasoning. According to the text of the book, it was a new name, not a full name. If you do have any kind of evidence to the contrary, please let me know. I do know that Fortuona does contain the name Tuon, but this might be a coincidence. Let me also welcome you to the wiki, and I hope that you continue to edit! ----[[User:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#000099;"> '''Willie'''</span>]] - [[User Talk:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#990099;">'''''HtS'''''</span>]] 01:51, February 20, 2010 (UTC)
